why: Soft milky tones with a take-off hooded cardigan and flat nude loafers suit a calm 13:00 city walk, and the mint panama gives it a light note of interest that o4's all-neutral look lacks. I accept the loafer edge against the skin, the orphan mint and the slightly above-target formality on purpose, because they are mild and none of them fights her easy weekend intent the way o3's two loud greens near the face or o2's emerald belt and earrings do.
